newsitem.title: USA: Winners Entertainment unit loan amended.
newsitem.headline: Winners Entertainment unit loan amended.

text.p: Winners Entertainment Inc said Wednesday that the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Northern District of New York has approved an amended loan agreement between a subsidiary and Bennett Management and Development Corp.
The company said it also will be changing its name to MTR Gaming Group Inc, and will begin trading under the symbol, MTNG.O on the Nasdaq as of Thursday.

Under the amended agreement, which is between its subsidiary Mountaineer Park Inc, and Bennett Management, Moutaineer will make principal payments of $75,000 per month from October through March and $125,000 per month from April through September.
The remaining principal balance will continue to be due on April 30, 1999, it said. The new payment schedule began with the payment due October 31, 1996.
Previously, Mountaineer was to have made 36 equal monthly principal payments of $283,333.
Winners Entertainment said that shareholders at the annual meeting on October 15 voted to change the name of the company to MTR Gaming Group Inc.
The company owns and operates the Mountaineer Racetrack and Gaming Resort in Chester, W. Va.
